title: Best Jewelry Designers for Hire (2026): Sketches and CAD Models
description: How to hire a jewelry designer for custom pieces, collections or CAD files for casting: materials, sizes, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Jewelry designers create rings, necklaces, earrings and bracelets, from hand sketches to 3D CAD models ready for printing and casting. A good designer combines beauty with practical details like ring sizes, stone settings and metal thickness. Projects go wrong when CAD files are not ready for manufacturing, stones do not fit settings, or designs are too fragile to wear. This guide helps you get jewelry designs a jeweler can make.

faq.q: Do I need a sketch or a CAD model?
faq.a: Sketches show the idea. CAD models are needed for 3D printing and casting by manufacturers.

faq.q: Which file format will I get?
faq.a: Often STL for printing plus renders. Ask your manufacturer which format they need.

faq.q: Can they design around a stone I have?
Will the design be strong enough?
faq.a: A good designer checks metal thickness and setting strength for daily wear.
Agree in writing, especially for collections you will sell.
